facts.fact: The Nigerian Communications Commission register lists Starlink Internet Services Nigeria Limited with nationwide Ku-Band and Ka-Band VSAT frequency licences effective 16 June 2026, alongside earlier gateway earth station licences from July 2022.
The Nigerian Communications Commission register lists Airtel Networks Limited with a nationwide Ku-Band VSAT frequency licence on the OneWeb constellation effective 24 January 2023.
